# KICC National Exhibition Platform
> The KICC Global Exhibition Platform is a digital twin of the Kenyatta International Convention Centre and all 47 Kenyan counties.

## Public Pages
- https://kicctest.org/
- https://kicctest.org/counties
- https://kicctest.org/marketplace
- https://kicctest.org/trade-agreements
- https://kicctest.org/export/eligibility

## Technical Stack
- Framework: Laravel 13.x on PHP 8.4
- Database: TiDB Cloud
- Edge: Cloudflare Workers
- Media: Cloudflare R2 CDN
